name: Platte County, NE
findings: Platte County has 115 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Platte County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
